pairs.target: dìsāncì dào cè yuàn , tǎ wéi bǎ liànxícè gē dào qiángbiān , xiān cèng gān xiédǐ , cái fāxiàn sòng yuǎn yǐ bǎ shéng lù gǎi kuān , shādài què duō bǎi le yìzhī , dàikǒu cháozhe tā .

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā hé lín kē dōu yào jìnqù , lín kē lán rén , tā zhǎo lù zǒu , liǎngduān liúxià de kōngkǒu dōu néng chūqù , dàn bùnéng cǎi shéng , yě bùnéng tuī rén .
pairs.english: This time he and Lin Ke would both enter, she blocking and he finding a way; either opening at the ends was an exit, but no stepping on rope or pushing anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他和林珂都要进去，林珂拦人，他找路走，两端留下的空口都能出去，但不能踩绳，也不能推人。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn ná zhe shuǐhú zhàn dào yìbiān , jiào liǎng rén xiān shuō tíng zì , shuí shuō le dōu děi tíng , bùxǔ cāi duìfāng shìbushì hái chēngdezhù .
pairs.english: Song Yuan stood aside with the water flask and had both say halt first; whoever said it, both must stop, without guessing whether the other could still hold on.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远拿着水壶站到一边，叫两人先说停字，谁说了都得停，不许猜对方是不是还撑得住。

pairs.target: lín kē shuō le , tǎ wéi yě shuō le yíbiàn , shēngyīn bú dà , sòng yuǎn méi jiào tā hǎn de xiàng zài yuàn ménwài tǎozhài , zhǐ diǎntóu shuō tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Lin Ke said it and Tavi repeated it softly; Song Yuan did not have him shout like a debt collector at the gate, only nodded and said he had heard.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂说了，塔维也说了一遍，声音不大，宋远没叫他喊得像在院门外讨债，只点头说听见了。

pairs.target: dìyīhuí tǎ wéi réng xiǎng cóng yuǎnchù nàge kǒu chūqù , lín kē wǎng zuǒ yízhàn , tā biàn rào yòu , rào dào yíbàn cái fāxiàn jiān biān zhǐ shèng shādài .
pairs.english: The first time Tavi still wanted to exit by the far opening; Lin Ke stood left, so he went right, only halfway around noticing that beside his shoulder there were nothing but sandbags.
pairs.hanzi: 第一回塔维仍想从远处那个口出去，林珂往左一站，他便绕右，绕到一半才发现肩边只剩沙袋。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng tíngzhù huàn jiǎo , tā què yǐ zǒujìn , zhǐjiān pèngshàng tā jiāntóu shí , tā zhāngkāi shǒu , yìng rěnzhù méi qù zhuā tā de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: He wanted to stop and change feet, but she had already approached; her fingertips touched his shoulder, and he opened his hand, forcing himself not to seize her sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 他想停住换脚，她却已走近，指尖碰上他肩头时，他张开手，硬忍住没去抓她的袖子。

pairs.english: After she moved away only then he let out his breath; his right palm did not hurt, but his arm ached, as though not grabbing that time had taken great effort too.
pairs.hanzi: 她退开后，他才把那口气吐出来，右掌没有疼，胳膊却酸，像那一下没抓出去也要费很大力气。

pairs.target: lín kē kànzhe tā , shuō gāngcái ruòzhēn yǒurén dǎ , guāng rěnzhù bù zhuā bìng bùnéng ràng rén tíng , tǎ wéi tīng le yǒuxiē nǎo , shuō zìjǐ zhīdào .
pairs.english: Lin Ke looked at him and said if someone truly struck just now, simply holding back from grabbing would not stop them; hearing this Tavi felt annoyed and said he knew.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂看着他，说刚才若真有人打，光忍住不抓并不能让人停，塔维听了有些恼，说自己知道。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō tā bùzhīhǎodǎi , dūnxiàqù bǎ pèng wāi de bùdài fúzhèng , sòng yuǎn yě méi tì shuí pínglǐ , jiào liǎng rén hēkǒushuǐ , xià yìhuí huàn zhe xiān dòng .
pairs.english: She did not call him ungrateful, but crouched to straighten the displaced bag; Song Yuan took neither side, telling both to drink water and take turns moving first next time.
pairs.hanzi: 她没说他不知好歹，蹲下去把碰歪的布袋扶正，宋远也没替谁评理，叫两人喝口水，下一回换着先动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hēwán yòu kàn nà zhī dài , xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài xiūlù shícháng cóng shítou páng ràoguòqù , dào le zhèlǐ què zǒng bǎ lín kē dàngchéng wéiyī gāi kàn de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi finished drinking and looked at the bag again, remembering how he often went around stones during road work, yet here always treated Lin Ke as the only thing worth watching.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝完又看那只袋，想起自己在修路时常从石头旁绕过去，到了这里却总把林珂当成唯一该看的东西。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí tā de jiǎo gāng wǎngqián , tā biàn shōuzhù le yuánběn wǎng yuǎnchù qù de bùzi , tuì xiàng zìjǐ jìnlái de kǒu , yǎnjīng méiyǒu líkāi tā , jiǎo què xiān zhǎo le dì .
pairs.english: The second time her foot just moved forward, he then checked his step, originally aimed toward the far end, and retreated to his entrance; his eyes stayed on her, but his feet found ground first.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回她的脚刚往前，他便收住了原本往远处去的步子，退向自己进来的口，眼睛没有离开她，脚却先找了地。

pairs.target: lín kē gēn guòlái , dàikǒu zài liǎng rén zhījiān , tā méi shēnjiǎo qù tī , zhǐ yán shéng biān zhuǎnshēn , zǒu dào kōngkǒu wài cái tíngxià .
pairs.english: Lin Ke followed, the bag mouth between them; he did not kick it, only turned along the rope and only then stopped once outside the opening.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂跟过来，袋口在两人之间，他没伸脚去踢，只沿绳边转身，走到空口外才停下。

pairs.target: lín kē yě tíng le , piēyìyǎn sòng yuǎn , shuō tā zhèhuí gēnběn méi guòqù , tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu hái tiào zhe , dá zìjǐ yǐjīng chūlái le .
pairs.english: Lin Ke stopped too, glanced at Song Yuan and said he had not gone past at all this time; Tavi’s heart still raced as he answered he had already got out.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂也停了，瞥一眼宋远，说他这回根本没过去，塔维胸口还跳着，答自己已经出来了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn xiào le yìshēng , bǎ hú fàngxià , méi tì tǎ wéi suàn yíng , zhǐ jiào lín kē kànkàn , fāngcái ruò hái zhuī bànbù , tā de hòujiǎo huì cǎi zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Song Yuan laughed, set the flask down, did not award Tavi a win, and only had Lin Ke look where her rear foot would land if she had chased another half-step just then.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远笑了一声，把壶放下，没替塔维算赢，只叫林珂看看，方才若还追半步，她的后脚会踩在哪里。

pairs.target: tā dītóu , jiǎogēn yǐ āizhe lìngyìzhī dài , táiqǐ láishí zìjǐ yě zhòu le méi , shuō zhè zhī gāngcái bú zài zhèér .
pairs.english: She looked down, her heel already against another bag; lifting it she frowned too and said this one had not been here a moment ago.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头，脚跟已挨着另一只袋，抬起来时自己也皱了眉，说这只刚才不在这儿。

pairs.english: Song Yuan said it had always been there, only she had been watching Tavi before; she wanted to argue, looked at the old impression pressed into the ground beside the bag and swallowed her words again.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说一直在，只是她先前看着塔维，她想反驳，望了望袋边压出来的旧印，又把话咽了回去。

pairs.english: After they changed places, Tavi learned blocking was not easy either; he tried watching the space on both sides of her, yet his feet followed her involuntarily.
pairs.hanzi: 两人换了位置后，塔维才知道拦路也不轻松，想看她两边的空处，脚下却不由自主地跟她走。

pairs.english: Lin Ke did not rush him, only shifted her shoulder, her foot turning the other way; he had barely moved when he knew he was late again.

pairs.english: Song Yuan put the rope back and asked if he wanted it recorded; Tavi said yes, then without waiting for a prompt said this time he had stepped on it, not that the bags were too close.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远将绳放回原处，问他要不要记，塔维说记，没等他补一句，自己先说这回是踩了，不是袋子太近。

pairs.target: rìtou piān guò yuànqiáng shí , sòng yuǎn shōu le dōngxī , tǎ wéi zhǐ cóng lín kē shēnbiān zǒuchū qùguò yícì , yī bèi què bǐ shàng huí gèng shī .
pairs.english: As the sun moved past the courtyard wall, Song Yuan packed up; Tavi had got out past Lin Ke only once, yet his shirt back was wetter than last time.
pairs.hanzi: 日头偏过院墙时，宋远收了东西，塔维只从林珂身边走出去过一次，衣背却比上回更湿。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐhú dì lái , tā yòng zuǒshǒu jiē , shuō tā gāngcái nà yíxià jiān huàng de zhēn xiàng yào zhuàng rén , lín kē shuō hái zǎo ne , zìjǐ yě zhǐ huì nà yìbiān .
pairs.english: She passed him the flask; he took it left-handed and said that shoulder movement had really looked like she would collide with him; Lin Ke said not yet, she could only do it on that side herself.
pairs.hanzi: 她把水壶递来，他用左手接，说她刚才那一下肩晃得真像要撞人，林珂说还早呢，自己也只会那一边。

pairs.target: huídào láng xià , wéi lǎoshī jiào tā bǎ yòushǒu tānkāi , pí yǐjīng hé hǎo , qīng pèng méiyǒu xiānqián de cìtòng , wò jiǔ le què réng qiān de jǐn .
pairs.english: Back under the gallery, Instructor Vey had him open his right hand; the skin had already closed, light touch no longer stung as before, but a long grip still pulled tight.
pairs.hanzi: 回到廊下，维老师叫他把右手摊开，皮已经合好，轻碰没有先前的刺痛，握久了却仍牵得紧。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā sāntiān hòu dài liànxícè lái , qǔ yuánxiān nà duì tiě zuò yícì zhàn zī jiǎnchá , háishì qīngzài , háishì tā zài pángbiān , bú pèng sòng yuǎn dùn lǐ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She told him to bring his practice book in three days for a standing check using his original iron pair, still lightly loaded and with her beside him, without touching Song Yuan’s shield pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他三天后带练习册来，取原先那对铁作一次站姿检查，还是轻载、还是她在旁边，不碰宋远盾里的东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì jiù néng liàn zhe dòng le , tā shuō xiān kàn tā zhàn zhe hái néng bunéng tóngshí gù zhù liǎngbiān , bù bǎ kànguò biérén shǐ chūlái dàngchéng zìjǐ yǐjīng huì le .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if he could then practise moving; she said first they would see whether he could attend to both sides at once while standing, without treating watching someone else do it as already knowing how himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是就能练着动了，她说先看他站着还能不能同时顾住两边，不把看过别人使出来当成自己已经会了。

pairs.english: He felt a little disappointed, but asked what shoes to bring; Instructor Vey looked at his soles rubbed pale and said this pair, dry.
pairs.hanzi: 他有点失望，却又问要带什么鞋，维老师看了看他擦得发白的鞋底，说就这双，干的。

pairs.target: lín kē cóng hòumiàn zhuīshànglái , wèn nàtiān sòng yuǎn tóng liáng jiàoxí guòzhāo , tā xiān kàn le shénme , tǎ wéi shuō dāo , tā xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō zìjǐ dàgài yě xiān kàn nàge .
pairs.english: Lin Ke caught up from behind and asked what he had watched first when Song Yuan sparred with Liang that day; Tavi said the blade, and she thought a moment and said she probably would watch that first too.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂从后面追上来，问那天宋远同梁教习过招，他先看了什么，塔维说刀，她想了想，说自己大概也先看那个。

pairs.english: Tavi took his practice book from the wall; they parted at the gallery entrance for their own classrooms; Tavi reached his door and only then noticed the book was backward, turning it with a flask-handle mark still on his left fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿回墙边的练习册，两个人在廊口分开，各去各的课室，塔维走到门前才发现手里的练习册拿反了，转过来时，左手指上还留着壶柄的一道印。
